stackDivergence.rationale: Native logical RTL/UNO/source pointer ownership and explicit lifetime lowering are retained; C++ physical standard-library/atomic/ABI layout is not claimed.

preservedResponsibilities: Binds native storage create/open, properties and transaction operations. Original default behavior catches UNO commit errors; the caller can opt into propagation on browser export.
omittedResponsibilities: Positive actual storage backend/substorage/copy/commit and full DOCX/XLSX core/model/export/UI acceptance; physical C++ standard-library/ABI/differential remain unfinished.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original synchronous native storage is distinct from the older asynchronous browser ZipStorage transport until the real XStorage/backend route is implemented; no hidden alias or cache substitute.
